description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MessageMappingFailedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when mapping of an external message fails, typically with details about content type issues and mapping errors.

classes.name: MessageMappingFailedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when message mapping fails within the connectivity module.

classes.name: MessageMappingFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class to construct instances of MessageMappingFailedException with a fluent API.

methods.name: MessageMappingFailedException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a message string and headers.

methods.name: MessageMappingFailedException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: MessageMappingFailedException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
